title: Cross-sectional resilience after BTC deleveraging shocks with metrics publication-lag normalization

provenance.reason_for_new_id: HY-EXP-0004 failed before PnL because official metrics create_time can lag its 5m period boundary by 1-6 seconds
provenance.data_rule_change: accept publication lag from 0 through 10000ms, normalize create_time down to its 5m period boundary, record the lag, and fail on larger lag or normalized collision

overrides.data.metrics_timestamp_semantics: create_time is publication time for the period; lag <=10s is assigned to the immediately preceding 5m boundary
overrides.interpretation.special_caveat: the 10s tolerance was frozen after observing 1-6s lags but before any H3 portfolio or PnL was computed
